_scenario: Brage's simple world on MAR-AST, scaled by 100 m per unit: 10 x 10 km of open water with no obstacles (make the map with: uv run python -m sim.marast.makeOpenWaterMap). The own ship starts at Brage's [0, 50] and goes straight east across. The adversary starts at Brage's [17, 0] heading north, and the solver steers it. Leaving the square ends the episode (grounding)
_own_route: Waypoints [north, east] written here, or a route file name in routes/ or MAR-AST's data/route/
_own_colav: "sbmpc": the own ship evades with SBMPC. "none": it follows its route without evading, like Brage's straight boat
_heading_gains: Boe (master-thesis repo, test_beds/ast_test/setup.py): own kd=66 ki=0.005, passive ship kd=75 ki=0.005. Weakly damped baseline is kd=0 ki=0
_adversary_mode: "route": the adversary follows adversary_route, and the action is a heading offset from it (max_heading_offset_deg, heading_offset_sigma_deg). "free": adversary_route is not used, see free_adversary
_free_adversary: start: "random", or a fixed {north, east, heading_deg} used every episode (heading 0 = north, 90 = east). Random: a position within start_radius m of start_center [north, east] (or of the point start_route_fraction along the own ship's route if start_center is left out), at least land_clearance m from land, and a random heading, all from the start seed. randomise_start_each_episode: every episode gets the next start seed (start_seed, start_seed+1, ...). Use it for SAC. MCTS needs a fixed start or randomise_start_each_episode false. Each action turns the heading by up to max_turn_deg, and p = exp(-turn^2/2 sigma^2), so going straight is the most likely
_reward: log(p) per action, then collision_reward or -miss_distance/miss_distance_scale at the end
_interpolate_closest_distance: true: the closest distance (and so the collision check and the reward) also counts how close the ships came between two sim steps, assuming straight lines within the step. false: only at the steps, as in the other parameter files
_swimmers: count swimmers on random paths, swimmer i with seed first_seed + i. A path only depends on its seed: the same seed always gives the same path, and it does not react to the ships or the solver. They start within start_radius m of the point route_fraction along the own ship's route. The own ship's SBMPC avoids them. A ship within 50 m of a swimmer stops (MAR-AST's collision check), which ends the episode without a found collision. count 0 turns them off
_environment: Wave, wind and current are off so that an action trace always replays to the same outcome
